description:
Project: “Private upgrade + rollback mechanism” (Private Deployment Automation: VPC + On‑Prem Packaging).

Goal
- Deliver a reliable, repeatable upgrade workflow for Redwood Private deployments (VPC and on‑prem/air‑gapped) that includes: (1) pre-upgrade safety checks, (2) automated backups/snapshots of critical state, (3) well-defined rollback hooks and operator UX, and (4) clear observability + support playbooks.

Scope (what changes)
- Upgrade orchestration: version selection, staged apply, health validation gates, and deterministic rollback plan.
- Prechecks: cluster readiness (Kubernetes version, node capacity, storage class), database schema compatibility, secrets/permissions, disk space, and config drift detection.
- Backups: control plane DB snapshots, object storage config/state backups, optional PV snapshots, and backup verification.
- Rollback: rollback hooks per component (control plane, runtime, gateways, observability agents), rollback ordering, and data migration strategy (forward-only vs reversible where feasible).
- Packaging + delivery: signed artifacts, upgrade bundles, Helm chart/installer coordination, and offline bundle flow for air‑gapped customers.
- Ops integration: SRE dashboards/alerts for upgrade runs, runbooks, and support escalation paths.

Non-goals
- Re-architecting the full private installer from scratch.
- Building a general-purpose “GitOps platform” for customers.
- Guaranteeing zero downtime in all customer environments (but minimizing downtime with safe sequencing/canaries is a requirement).

Stakeholders
- Product: Vivek Kulkarni (Private Deployments).
- Engineering: Connor O’Brien (Release Eng), Ethan Park / Platform Control Plane (upgrade APIs + state), Infra/SRE leadership (Neha Kapoor, Sean Gallagher), Security Eng (Marcus Lin / Dr. Aisha Rahman) for signing, secrets handling, and auditability.
- Solutions/PS: Markus Klein org (customer implementation + beta pilots).

Deliverables
- A documented end-to-end upgrade/rollback design and a small set of ADRs.
- Installer/Helm changes implementing prechecks, backups, upgrade steps, and rollback.
- Automated test plan (upgrade simulation matrix) and release gating criteria.
- Operator runbooks and customer-facing “day-2 ops” guidance.

Timeline (hypothetical)
- Phase 1 (2–3 weeks): requirements, design doc + ADRs, define compatibility and rollback policy.
- Phase 2 (4–6 weeks): implement prechecks + backup primitives + upgrade orchestration in installer/charts; add telemetry.
- Phase 3 (2–3 weeks): hardening, failure injection, documentation, beta with 1–2 Private customers.
- Phase 4 (1–2 weeks): GA criteria, release notes, support enablement.

Constraints / risk areas
- Air‑gapped delivery and artifact integrity (signing/verification) are mandatory for on‑prem.
- Data migration compatibility: avoid irreversible schema changes without explicit guardrails and downgrade strategy.
- Upgrade safety: prevent partial upgrades that leave the deployment in an unrecoverable state; require “abort/rollback” paths and operator guidance.
- Supportability: produce diagnostics bundles and clear logs to accelerate triage when upgrades fail.

files.description: Primary design overview: upgrade phases, component ordering, state model, failure modes, and how rollback is triggered (auto vs manual). Includes diagrams-in-text and explicit invariants.
Spec for pre-upgrade checks: required cluster versions, storage classes, free space, permissions, secret availability, connectivity checks, and how failures are surfaced to operators.
Backup scope and procedures: what gets backed up, snapshot/restore mechanisms per environment (VPC vs on‑prem), verification steps, RPO/RTO expectations, and retention guidance.
Policy doc defining supported rollback windows, constraints for schema migrations, version skew rules, and the official stance on downgrade support across components.
On‑prem/air‑gapped packaging format: bundle contents, manifest schema, artifact signing/verification steps, and operator workflow for importing bundles.
Release engineering standard for signing private installer artifacts, provenance metadata, and verification behavior in the installer (including failure handling).
SRE/operator runbook for executing an upgrade: prerequisites, step-by-step commands, what to monitor, common failure modes, and rollback procedure.
Day‑2 ops guidance: logs/metrics emitted by the upgrade controller, dashboards to use, how to collect diagnostics bundles, and escalation checklist for Support/PS.
Process/policy: change windows, approval requirements for enterprise/private upgrades, comms templates, and how to coordinate upgrades with customer stakeholders.
PRD: Private upgrade + rollback mechanism. Goals, customer pain, requirements (VPC/on‑prem), success metrics, and GA criteria.
Initiative ticket: implement upgrade workflow with prechecks, backups, rollback hooks. Breaks down phases, owners, and links to Confluence design docs.
Define version compatibility matrix (control plane/runtime/helm charts) + enforce in installer. Acceptance criteria include explicit error messages and docs updates.
Implement precheck framework in redwood-private-installer (pluggable checks, severity levels, and JSON report output).
Add backup primitive: snapshot control-plane DB + config state with verification step and retention policy. Includes testing plan for restore drill.
Rollback hooks per component: design contract for pre/post hooks, ordering, and how to mark rollback-safe boundaries during an upgrade.
Air‑gapped offline bundle import + verification flow. Includes artifact manifest format and signature validation behavior.
Helm chart changes to support upgrade sequencing (jobs/hooks), readiness gates, and safe restart policy. Includes backwards-compat notes.
Upgrade telemetry: metrics + structured logs for each step, correlation id, and exportable diagnostics bundle.
Failure injection test matrix for upgrade/rollback (disk full, image pull failures, schema mismatch, API unavailable). Automate in CI where possible.
GA readiness checklist: runbook completeness, upgrade time targets, support enablement, and required dashboards/alerts.
Security review: secrets handling during backup, bundle signing keys, and audit logging requirements for upgrade actions.
Customer beta plan: select 1–2 Private customers, define success criteria, schedule upgrade windows, and feedback loop into backlog.
PR: Add `upgrade plan` command with step graph output and version compatibility validation. Includes unit tests and docs updates.
PR: Implement precheck runner framework (standardized results, severity, remediation hints) and initial checks (k8s version, disk space, permissions).
PR: Add backup step for control-plane DB (snapshot + verify) and wire into upgrade flow with rollback trigger on failure.
PR: Implement rollback command that re-applies previous chart versions and restores snapshots when safe; includes guardrails and prompts.
PR: Add offline bundle import (air‑gapped) with manifest parsing and signature verification; includes error UX for invalid bundles.
PR: Emit structured upgrade logs and create a diagnostics tarball (precheck report, step timings, k8s events, recent pod logs).
PR: Add integration test harness to simulate failed mid-upgrade and ensure rollback path restores service health within target time.
PR: Introduce helm hooks/jobs for schema migration gating and post-upgrade smoke tests; document ordering guarantees.
PR: Add chart values for backup targets/retention and feature-flagged rollback hooks; ensure defaults are safe for existing installs.
PR: Fix upgrade edge case where gateway rollout starts before control plane is ready; adds readiness gate and timeout tuning.
PR: Control plane API endpoint to report deployment component versions and compatibility; used by installer prechecks.
PR: Add audit log events for upgrade/rollback actions (who/when/what version) for Private deployments.
PR: Add DB migration metadata table to support downgrade guardrails and detect forward-only migrations.
PR: Terraform module outputs needed for installer prechecks (cluster endpoint, storage class, snapshot permissions) and docs for Private customers.
PR: Add dashboards/alerts for upgrade execution: step duration, failure counts, rollback triggers, and per-customer upgrade status panels.
PR: Add workflow to tag incidents as upgrade-related and auto-link relevant diagnostics bundle locations in Slack incident threads.
PR: Draft customer-facing docs for Private upgrades: prerequisites, maintenance windows, and how to collect diagnostics for Support.
PR: Tighten precheck messaging and remediation hints based on beta feedback; adds ‘--json’ output for Support ingestion.
PR: Add explicit rollback annotations and pre-stop hooks for critical components to reduce split-brain during downgrade.
PR: Add ‘upgrade correlation id’ propagation in control plane logs so installer step ids can be traced across services.
